transcript_title: Analyzing code in CRAN packages in R

source_files.transcript_file: raw-data/inspiration/Analyzing code in CRAN packages in R.txt

analysis_intent: Explore and compare language patterns in code in CRAN packages using tokenization, grouped counts, and discriminative text analysis
execution_notes: interactive `View()` calls are present and should be skipped or replaced in automated runs
local TidyTuesday files were matched, so you can use `load_tidyweek_data()` and avoid a GitHub PAT
fails_when: dataset has no natural grouping variable — comparisons become meaningless
column names are unstable across TidyTuesday editions (re-check schema each year)
text is multilingual without language detection
join key has trailing whitespace or case inconsistency — produces unexpected NAs
works_when: dataset has clear categorical + numeric columns for grouped comparisons
question is exploratory — no strong prior hypothesis
text is long-form English and benefits from word-level decomposition

steps: Tokenize text, remove stopwords, compute frequencies
Build 3-4 core ggplot charts telling the main story
LDA / STM topic model (if corpus large enough)
Sentiment arc if temporal dimension present
Quarto doc: code_cran_packages_report.qmd with params for data year
Hero chart: single best visualisation at 1200×628 (social media ratio)
Instagram carousel: 5 slides (hook → data → insight → method → CTA)
Shiny widget or Observable/D3 for one interactive element
TheDataShrink™ post template: title, 3 bullets, hashtags, link to episode page
